results.label: yes
results.reason: elections_process/national: ECI's Special Intensive Revision and digitization of electoral rolls.

notes.subject: polity
notes.why_in_news: The Election Commission of India (ECI) reported the progress of digitising enumeration forms during the second phase of the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls.
notes.fact_box: The ECI has digitised over 3.48 crore enumeration forms (68% of existing electors) across 12 States and UTs. The SIR process involves Booth Level Officers (BLOs) uploading data to the ECI website via dedicated apps.

prelims_pointers.text: ECI: The constitutional body responsible for administering elections to Parliament and State Legislatures.

SIR Phase 2 covers 12 States/UTs including Chhattisgarh, Goa, Gujarat, Kerala, Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Tamil Nadu, Uttar Pradesh, West Bengal, Puducherry, Andaman and Nicarobar Islands, and Laksha…
The digitisation process utilizes dedicated mobile applications for real-time data uploading by Booth Level Officers (BLOs).

notes.mains_question: Discuss how the digitisation of electoral rolls contributes to the integrity of the democratic process and the 'One Nation, One Election' discourse.

notes.subject: ir
notes.why_in_news: President Vladimir Putin is scheduled to visit India in December 2025 for the 23rd India-Russia Annual Summit to review strategic and defense cooperation.
notes.fact_box: The visit is scheduled for December 4-5, 2025, at the invitation of PM Narendra Modi. The summit will focus on defense (S-400, Su-57), space, energy, and trade cooperation under the 'Special and Privileged Strategic Partnership'.

prelims_pointers.text: The 2025 visit marks the 23rd India-Russia Annual Summit.
Key defense projects for review include the S-400 missile system and Su-57 fighter jets.
Vladimir Putin assumed the role of Acting President of Russia on December 31, 1999.
The diplomatic relationship is characterized as a 'Special and Privileged Strategic Partnership'.

notes.mains_question: Analyze the evolution of the India-Russia 'Special and Privileged Strategic Partnership' in the context of shifting global geopolitical dynamics.
